text:
Maya H: Heads-up: small but breaking change spotted in v2 SDK — parameter `stop_sequences` renamed to `stoppers` and a catalog model swap changed tokenizer defaults. We need a one-pager migration note + update snippets across py/ts. Who can own?
Omar S: I can own the PR. Will update snippets and add a regression paragraph.
Rina V: I'll scan Python examples and the quickstart. Found two notebooks using `stop_sequences`.
docs-bot: Reminder: include runnable snippets and a QA checklist in PR.
Maya H: Keep banner short: "Update SDK calls: stop_sequences -> stoppers. Re-run prompt smoke-tests."
Omar S: Draft snippet for TS below — showing old vs new inline.

```js
// v1 (old)
// const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-chat', input: prompt, stop_sequences: ['\n\n'] })

// v2 (new)
const resp = await client.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-chat-v2',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
  stoppers: ['\n\n']
})
```

Rina V: For Python patch: will replace ClientV1.generate with client.chat.create and run notebook smoke-tests.
link-bot: Found 2 docs linking to /v1/ examples; attaching report to the PR.
Maya H: Add a note: "Tokenization differences may change token counts >10% for prompts with special whitespace/HTML."
Omar S: Adding QA checklist to PR: 1) run py/ts snippets, 2) diff token counts on sample set, 3) smoke-test streaming=false if framing is flaky.
Rina V: Ops wants rollback steps — include Console pin example: model: 'redwood-chat@2026-02-01'.
Omar S: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410  includes snippets, banner, QA checklist, and link report. Assigning reviewers: @Rina V, @Maya H.
Maya H: Will review. If snippet smoke-tests fail due to streaming framing, default to streaming:false in examples and add a short explanation.
Rina V: Reviewing now. Left one nit about imports in python notebook.
Maya H: LGTM after nit fix. Merge after CI green and ops confirm canary.

Omar S: Merged. Post-merge: created redirect for /v1/ pages for 30 days.
Maya H: TL;DR: owner=Omar, reviewers=Rina/Maya, items=param rename, snippets updated, QA checklist, redirect rules, rollback pin. Target: deprecate v1 shim next week. :rocket:
